scope: Newest-first ME5: both Thievul prints, copy opponent field only with no cards in actual actor Hand; artwork and true BREAK excluded.

ruleReferences.facts: Thievul SkillThief: only if own Hand empty choose one attack of opponent in-play Pokemon and use it as this attack.
SkillThief copied MatchaSpin uses actual actor discard; copied NinjaSpinner additional damage can be chosen without Water Energy.

evidence.name: Skill Thief
evidence.textEn: If you have no cards in your hand, choose an attack from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon in play and use it as this attack.
evidence.textZh: 如果自己1张手牌都没有的话，则选择1个对手的场上宝可梦持有的招式，作为这个招式使用。
